method: Complete actual files, 16 MHz/8 kHz, production FIFO32/prefill24, gain128 and assembly ISR on both arithmetic backends. Same hardware/observer source; LG replaces only decoder and original private ROM API shortcuts. No physical board measurement.
quality_scope: Four source clips, P4/P6, current calls4. STOI/SSE/full-band diagnostics; no blinded listening test.
paired_cpu_scope: Decoded-source-sample-weighted complete files that fit each target/backend. Missing Flash rows are never simulated; see paired case names. Required CPU includes measured mean ISR cost and is an estimate for underrunning C/Tiny, whose empty FIFO ISR branch is cheaper.

inputs.method: same canonical16/15 Kaiser5 FIR, float64, round-to-even PCM16; no fitted gain/delay

optional_refit.scope: Whole-output admitted pulse changes only; not part of frozen AVR matrix.
